SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Services Agreement is entered into as of January 1, 2024, by and between Acme Corp ("Provider") and Beta LLC ("Customer"). Provider shall perform the services described in Exhibit A. This Agreement is governed by the laws of Delaware.

AGREEMENT AND PLAN OF MERGER

This Agreement and Plan of Merger is entered into by Parent Inc., Merger Sub Inc., and Target Corp. At the Effective Time, Merger Sub shall merge with and into Target, and each share of Target common stock shall be converted into the right to receive $25.00 in cash.
AMENDED AND RESTATED BYLAWS of HarborPoint Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation. The Board of Directors shall consist of not fewer than three members. The fiscal year shall end on December 31.

NOTICE OF BREACH AND DEMAND FOR PAYMENT

This firm represents Northwind Logistics. Three invoices totaling $218,440 remain unpaid. Demand is made for payment within ten days.
FIRST NOTICE OF LOSS. Policy number GL-4419. Insured HarborPoint Holdings reports a warehouse fire on March 3, 2025. Estimated reserve $85,000.
